commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+1' A pass lands at the feet of Ansu Fati (Barcelona) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' The attendance is 48843.

87' What a wasted opportunity by Jofre (Espanyol)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Inaki Pena makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
85' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Gavi (Barcelona) replaces Pedri.
85' Substitution. Raphinha leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ansu Fati (Barcelona).
82' Pedri (Barcelona) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' The corner kick from Raphinha (Barcelona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Romero trots off the pitch and is replaced by Brian Olivan (Espanyol).
78' Here is a change. Omar El Hilali is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Naci Unuvar (Espanyol).
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) for Hector Fort.
74' Manolo Gonzalez (Espanyol) gets a yellow card, off the field.
73' Espanyol take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
71' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:8.
65' Raphinha (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

65' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Joan Garcia makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
63' 3 - 1 It's 3:1! Carlos Romero feeds Javi Puado (Espanyol) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
62' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Rafel Bauza will be replaced by Justin Smith (Espanyol).
62' The referee signals a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Aguado.
60' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Javi Puado (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Espanyol will take a corner.
59' The goal by Espanyol won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
58' Wait! Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero has indicated he is going to review the Espanyol goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
58' Goal! Jofre puts the ball across the area and Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:0.
57' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
56' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Dani Olmo and he is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
56' Substitution. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) has come on for Marc Casado.
54' Rafel Bauza (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
54' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
53' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Espanyol get a corner. Carlos Romero (Espanyol) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
50' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
49' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

45+6' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+5' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is caught offside!
45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

45+4' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
45+2' Flag up against Jofre (Espanyol). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Barcelona). The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
42' Marc Casado (Barcelona) is able to continue to play.
41' Marc Casado (Barcelona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes the corner with a short pass.
40' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
40' Manolo Gonzalez is forced to make a change. Marash Kumbulla is unable to continue due to injury, Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) comes on.

39' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee blows his whistle, Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
39' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
34' The possession of the ball – 79:21.

31' 3 - 0 Brilliant finish! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Alejandro Balde, then produced a nice strike into the left side of the goal. The score is 3:0.
28' Celebrations are cut short for Espanyol as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
28' The Espanyol players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
27' Omar El Hilali provides Jofre (Espanyol) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
26' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

26' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
23' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! Marc Casado found Raphinha (Barcelona) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Joan Garcia off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
21' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.
21' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Barcelona win a corner.
18' Wasted opportunity. Javi Puado (Espanyol) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
16' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) commits a foul and Jose Luis Munuera Montero immediately signals a free kick.
14' Jofre (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
12' 1 - 0 Dani Olmo (Barcelona) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and scores! His shot ricochets in off the crossbar. What a strike!
11' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Jofre (Espanyol) for his blatant foul.
11' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.

10' That didn't go as planned! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Joan Garcia, who easily kept it out.
9' Some great play by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Joan Garcia sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
8' What a chance that is! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
8' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Luis Munuera Montero no option but to blow his whistle.
6' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is penalised for holding. Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals a set piece.

2' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
1' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
